namespace Acme\Reference\Console\Command;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Api\SearchCriteriaBuilder;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Helper\Table;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * bin/magento acme:reference:items:list [--status=1]
 *
 * Pattern: registered in etc/di.xml (CommandListInterface); heavy dependencies arrive as \Proxy
 * (every bin/magento call builds every command, so constructors must stay cheap); return
 * Command::SUCCESS or Command::FAILURE.
 */
class ListItems extends Command
{
    private const OPTION_STATUS = 'status';

    /**
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository injected as Proxy (etc/di.xml)
     * @param SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository,
        private readonly SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->setName('acme:reference:items:list')
            ->setDescription('Lists the reference items')
            ->addOption(self::OPTION_STATUS, null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Only items with this status (0 or 1)');
        parent::configure();
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $status = $input->getOption(self::OPTION_STATUS);
        if ($status !== null) {
            if (!in_array($status, ['0', '1'], true)) {
                $output->writeln('<error>--status must be 0 or 1</error>');
                return Command::FAILURE;
            }
            $this->searchCriteriaBuilder->addFilter(ItemInterface::STATUS, (int)$status);
        }
        $items = $this->itemRepository->getList($this->searchCriteriaBuilder->create())->getItems();

        $table = new Table($output);
        $table->setHeaders(['ID', 'Code', 'Name', 'Status']);
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $table->addRow([$item->getId(), $item->getCode(), $item->getName(), $item->getStatus()]);
        }
        $table->render();
        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}

use Magento\Framework\App\Action\HttpPostActionInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Controller\ResultInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\LocalizedException;

/**
 * Delete (POST: the form's Delete button posts with deleteConfirm). Goes through the repository,
 * so the protection in ItemRepositoryPlugin::aroundDeleteById applies here too.
 */
class Delete extends Action implements HttpPostActionInterface
{
    public const ADMIN_RESOURCE = 'Acme_Reference::item_delete';

    /**
     * @param Context $context
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     */
    public function __construct(
        Context $context,
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
    ) {
        parent::__construct($context);
    }

    /**
     * @return ResultInterface
     */
    public function execute(): ResultInterface
    {
        $redirect = $this->resultRedirectFactory->create();
        $id = (int)$this->getRequest()->getParam('id');
        if (!$id) {
            $this->messageManager->addErrorMessage(__('We can\'t find an item to delete.'));
            return $redirect->setPath('*/*/');
        }
        try {
            $this->itemRepository->deleteById($id);
            $this->messageManager->addSuccessMessage(__('The item has been deleted.'));
            return $redirect->setPath('*/*/');
        } catch (LocalizedException $e) {
            $this->messageManager->addErrorMessage($e->getMessage());
        }
        return $redirect->setPath('*/*/edit', ['id' => $id]);
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Controller\Adminhtml\Item;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Magento\Backend\App\Action;
use Magento\Backend\App\Action\Context;
use Magento\Framework\App\Action\HttpPostActionInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Controller\Result\JsonFactory;
use Magento\Framework\Controller\ResultInterface;

/**
 * Grid inline edit (editorConfig.clientConfig.saveUrl in the listing XML). Receives
 * items[<id>][<field>] and answers JSON {messages: [], error: bool}, the shape the grid expects.
 * Only the columns that have an <editor> in the listing are accepted.
 */
class InlineEdit extends Action implements HttpPostActionInterface
{
    public const ADMIN_RESOURCE = 'Acme_Reference::item_save';

    /**
     * @param Context $context
     * @param JsonFactory $jsonFactory
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     */
    public function __construct(
        Context $context,
        private readonly JsonFactory $jsonFactory,
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
    ) {
        parent::__construct($context);
    }

    /**
     * @return ResultInterface
     */
    public function execute(): ResultInterface
    {
        $result = $this->jsonFactory->create();
        $items = (array)$this->getRequest()->getParam('items', []);
        if (!$this->getRequest()->getParam('isAjax') || !$items) {
            return $result->setData(['messages' => [__('Please correct the data sent.')], 'error' => true]);
        }
        $messages = [];
        foreach ($items as $itemId => $fields) {
            try {
                $item = $this->itemRepository->getById((int)$itemId);
                if (isset($fields[ItemInterface::CODE])) {
                    $item->setCode((string)$fields[ItemInterface::CODE]);
                }
                if (isset($fields[ItemInterface::NAME])) {
                    $item->setName((string)$fields[ItemInterface::NAME]);
                }
                if (isset($fields[ItemInterface::STATUS])) {
                    $item->setStatus((int)$fields[ItemInterface::STATUS]);
                }
                $this->itemRepository->save($item);
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                $messages[] = __('[ID %1] %2', $itemId, $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        return $result->setData(['messages' => $messages, 'error' => (bool)$messages]);
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Controller\Adminhtml\Item;

use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Model\ResourceModel\Item\CollectionFactory;
use Magento\Backend\App\Action;
use Magento\Backend\App\Action\Context;
use Magento\Framework\App\Action\HttpPostActionInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Controller\ResultInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\LocalizedException;
use Magento\Ui\Component\MassAction\Filter;

/**
 * Grid mass action. Filter::getCollection() applies what the user selected (or "select all" with
 * the grid filters). Each item goes through the repository, so plugins and events run; a failure
 * in one item does not stop the others.
 */
class MassDelete extends Action implements HttpPostActionInterface
{
    public const ADMIN_RESOURCE = 'Acme_Reference::item_delete';

    /**
     * @param Context $context
     * @param Filter $filter
     * @param CollectionFactory $collectionFactory
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     */
    public function __construct(
        Context $context,
        private readonly Filter $filter,
        private readonly CollectionFactory $collectionFactory,
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
    ) {
        parent::__construct($context);
    }

    /**
     * @return ResultInterface
     * @throws LocalizedException
     */
    public function execute(): ResultInterface
    {
        $collection = $this->filter->getCollection($this->collectionFactory->create());
        $deleted = 0;
        foreach ($collection->getAllIds() as $itemId) {
            try {
                $this->itemRepository->deleteById((int)$itemId);
                $deleted++;
            } catch (LocalizedException $e) {
                $this->messageManager->addErrorMessage($e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        if ($deleted) {
            $this->messageManager->addSuccessMessage(__('A total of %1 record(s) have been deleted.', $deleted));
        }
        return $this->resultRedirectFactory->create()->setPath('*/*/');
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Cron;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Model\Config;
use Magento\Framework\Api\SearchCriteriaBuilder;
use Magento\Framework\Stdlib\DateTime\DateTime;
use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

/**
 * Cron job (etc/crontab.xml). Runs without a request, store or session: everything it needs comes
 * from config and the repository. Work in pages, never load the whole table; one failing item is
 * logged and does not stop the others.
 */
class DeactivateStaleItems
{
    private const PAGE_SIZE = 200;

    /**
     * @param Config $config
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     * @param SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder
     * @param DateTime $dateTime
     * @param LoggerInterface $logger
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly Config $config,
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository,
        private readonly SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder,
        private readonly DateTime $dateTime,
        private readonly LoggerInterface $logger
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @return void
     */
    public function execute(): void
    {
        if (!$this->config->isEnabled()) {
            return;
        }
        $limit = $this->dateTime->gmtDate('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime(sprintf('-%d days', $this->config->getCleanupDays())));
        $criteria = $this->searchCriteriaBuilder
            ->addFilter(ItemInterface::STATUS, ItemInterface::STATUS_ENABLED)
            ->addFilter(ItemInterface::UPDATED_AT, $limit, 'lt')
            ->setPageSize(self::PAGE_SIZE)
            ->setCurrentPage(1)
            ->create();

        $deactivated = 0;
        foreach ($this->itemRepository->getList($criteria)->getItems() as $item) {
            try {
                $item->setStatus(ItemInterface::STATUS_DISABLED);
                $this->itemRepository->save($item);
                $deactivated++;
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                $this->logger->error('Could not deactivate item', ['item_id' => $item->getId(), 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            }
        }
        if ($deactivated > 0) {
            $this->logger->info('Stale items deactivated', ['count' => $deactivated]);
        }
    }
}

 * Typed access to the module configuration (etc/adminhtml/system.xml, defaults in etc/config.xml).
 *
 * Pattern:
 * - one constant per path; nobody else reads these paths directly;
 * - store scope by default: the value configured for the store view wins over website and default;
 * - an "obscure" field with the Encrypted backend is stored encrypted: decrypt it here;
 * - URLs and credentials always come from config, never from a literal in the code (C6/C8).
 */
class Config
{
    public const XML_PATH_ENABLED = 'acme_reference/general/enabled';
    public const XML_PATH_DEFAULT_STATUS = 'acme_reference/general/default_status';
    public const XML_PATH_CLEANUP_DAYS = 'acme_reference/general/cleanup_days';
    public const XML_PATH_API_ENDPOINT = 'acme_reference/api/endpoint';
    public const XML_PATH_API_TOKEN = 'acme_reference/api/token';
    public const XML_PATH_API_TIMEOUT = 'acme_reference/api/timeout';
    public const XML_PATH_NOTIFICATION_ENABLED = 'acme_reference/notification/enabled';
    public const XML_PATH_NOTIFICATION_RECIPIENT = 'acme_reference/notification/recipient';
    public const XML_PATH_NOTIFICATION_IDENTITY = 'acme_reference/notification/identity';
    public const XML_PATH_NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE = 'acme_reference/notification/template';

    /**
     * @param ScopeConfigInterface $scopeConfig
     * @param EncryptorInterface $encryptor
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ScopeConfigInterface $scopeConfig,
        private readonly EncryptorInterface $encryptor
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param int|null $storeId
     * @return bool
     */
    public function isEnabled(?int $storeId = null): bool
    {
        return $this->scopeConfig->isSetFlag(self::XML_PATH_ENABLED, ScopeInterface::SCOPE_STORE, $storeId);
    }

    /**
     * @param int|null $storeId
     * @return int
     */
    public function getDefaultStatus(?int $storeId = null): int
    {
        return (int)$this->scopeConfig->getValue(self::XML_PATH_DEFAULT_STATUS, ScopeInterface::SCOPE_STORE, $storeId);
    }

    /**
     * Global setting: the cron runs once for all stores.
     *
     * @return int
     */
    public function getCleanupDays(): int
    {
        return max(1, (int)$this->scopeConfig->getValue(self::XML_PATH_CLEANUP_DAYS));
    }

    /**
     * @param int|null $storeId
     * @return string
     */
    public function getApiEndpoint(?int $storeId = null): string
    {
        return rtrim(
            (string)$this->scopeConfig->getValue(self::XML_PATH_API_ENDPOINT, ScopeInterface::SCOPE_STORE, $storeId),
            '/'
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param int|null $storeId
     * @return string

    public function getApiToken(?int $storeId = null): string
    {
        $value = (string)$this->scopeConfig->getValue(self::XML_PATH_API_TOKEN, ScopeInterface::SCOPE_STORE, $storeId);
        return $value === '' ? '' : $this->encryptor->decrypt($value);
    }

    /**

     * @return int seconds
     */
    public function getApiTimeout(?int $storeId = null): int
    {
        $timeout = (int)$this->scopeConfig->getValue(self::XML_PATH_API_TIMEOUT, ScopeInterface::SCOPE_STORE, $storeId);
        return $timeout > 0 ? $timeout : 10;
    }

    /**
     * @param int|null $storeId
     * @return bool

    public function isNotificationEnabled(?int $storeId = null): bool
    {
        return $this->scopeConfig->isSetFlag(
            self::XML_PATH_NOTIFICATION_ENABLED,
            ScopeInterface::SCOPE_STORE,
            $storeId
        );
    }

    /**

    {

            ScopeInterface::SCOPE_STORE,
            $storeId
        );
    }

     *
     * @param int|null $storeId

    public function getNotificationTemplate(?int $storeId = null): string
    {

namespace Acme\Reference\Model\Email;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Model\Config;
use Magento\Framework\App\Area;
use Magento\Framework\Mail\Template\TransportBuilder;
use Magento\Framework\Translate\Inline\StateInterface;
use Magento\Store\Model\Store;
use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

/**
 * Transactional e-mail.
 *
 * Pattern:
 * - the template id comes from config; its default is declared in etc/email_templates.xml and the
 *   file lives in view/frontend/email/ (a template id with no file breaks only when the e-mail is
 *   sent, far from the code that caused it);
 * - the sender is an identity code (general, sales...) resolved per store by setFromByScope();
 * - template vars are scalars (an object would need {{var item.name}} and public getters);
 * - inline translation is suspended while the e-mail is built and always resumed;
 * - TransportBuilder is Magento\Framework\Mail\Template\TransportBuilder; the transport it returns
 *   implements Magento\Framework\Mail\TransportInterface (there is no Mail\Template\TransportInterface).
 */
class ItemNotificationSender
{
    /**
     * @param Config $config
     * @param TransportBuilder $transportBuilder
     * @param StateInterface $inlineTranslation
     * @param LoggerInterface $logger
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly Config $config,
        private readonly TransportBuilder $transportBuilder,
        private readonly StateInterface $inlineTranslation,
        private readonly LoggerInterface $logger
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param ItemInterface $item
     * @return bool true when an e-mail was sent
     */
    public function send(ItemInterface $item): bool
    {
        $storeId = $item->getStoreId() ?: Store::DEFAULT_STORE_ID;
        $recipient = $this->config->getNotificationRecipient($storeId);
        if (!$this->config->isNotificationEnabled($storeId) || $recipient === '') {
            return false;
        }
        $this->inlineTranslation->suspend();
        try {
            $this->transportBuilder
                ->setTemplateIdentifier($this->config->getNotificationTemplate($storeId))
                ->setTemplateOptions(['area' => Area::AREA_FRONTEND, 'store' => $storeId])
                ->setTemplateVars([
                    'item_code' => (string)$item->getCode(),
                    'item_name' => (string)$item->getName(),
                ])
                ->setFromByScope($this->config->getNotificationIdentity($storeId), $storeId)
                ->addTo($recipient)
                ->getTransport()
                ->sendMessage();
            return true;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->logger->error('Could not send the item notification', ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            return false;
        } finally {
            $this->inlineTranslation->resume();
        }
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Model\Http;

use Acme\Reference\Model\Config;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\LocalizedException;
use Magento\Framework\HTTP\Client\CurlFactory;
use Magento\Framework\Serialize\Serializer\Json;
use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

/**
 * Client of an external REST API.
 *
 * Pattern:
 * - endpoint, token and timeout come from config (never a URL literal: C6/C8), token decrypted;
 * - CurlFactory (generated) creates one client per call: the client keeps headers and state;
 * - every non-2xx answer and every invalid JSON becomes a LocalizedException with a clear message;
 * - the log never contains the token or the full payload (personal data).
 */
class ExternalItemClient
{
    /**
     * @param Config $config
     * @param CurlFactory $curlFactory
     * @param Json $json
     * @param LoggerInterface $logger
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly Config $config,
        private readonly CurlFactory $curlFactory,
        private readonly Json $json,
        private readonly LoggerInterface $logger
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param int|null $storeId
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     * @throws LocalizedException
     */
    public function fetchItems(?int $storeId = null): array
    {
        $endpoint = $this->config->getApiEndpoint($storeId);
        if ($endpoint === '') {
            throw new LocalizedException(__('The external API endpoint is not configured.'));
        }
        $curl = $this->curlFactory->create();
        $curl->setTimeout($this->config->getApiTimeout($storeId));
        $curl->addHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        $token = $this->config->getApiToken($storeId);
        if ($token !== '') {
            $curl->addHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer ' . $token);
        }

        $url = $endpoint . '/items';
        try {
            $curl->get($url);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->logger->error('External API unreachable', ['url' => $url, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            throw new LocalizedException(__('The external API is unreachable.'), $e);
        }
        $status = $curl->getStatus();
        if ($status < 200 || $status >= 300) {
            $this->logger->error('External API error', ['url' => $url, 'status' => $status]);
            throw new LocalizedException(__('The external API answered with HTTP %1.', $status));
        }
        try {
            $data = $this->json->unserialize($curl->getBody());
        } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            throw new LocalizedException(__('The external API answered with invalid JSON.'), $e);
        }
        return is_array($data) ? array_values(array_filter($data, 'is_array')) : [];
    }
}

/**

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Reference\Model;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemSearchResultsInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemSearchResultsInterfaceFactory;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Model\ResourceModel\Item as ItemResource;
use Acme\Reference\Model\ResourceModel\Item\CollectionFactory;
use Magento\Framework\Api\SearchCriteria\CollectionProcessorInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Api\SearchCriteriaInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\AlreadyExistsException;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\CouldNotDeleteException;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\CouldNotSaveException;
use Magento\Framework\Exception\NoSuchEntityException;

/**
 * Repository: the service contract implementation.
 *
 * Pattern:
 * - save() with an id merges ONLY the fields that came in (REST PUT, GraphQL update): building a
 *   new object and saving it would wipe the fields the caller did not send (defect class C9);
 * - getList() delegates filters, sorting and paging to CollectionProcessorInterface;
 * - not found is NoSuchEntityException; save and delete failures are wrapped in
 *   CouldNotSave/CouldNotDelete, which the Web API turns into HTTP 400.
 */
class ItemRepository implements ItemRepositoryInterface
{
    /**
     * @param ItemResource $resource
     * @param ItemFactory $itemFactory
     * @param CollectionFactory $collectionFactory
     * @param ItemSearchResultsInterfaceFactory $searchResultsFactory
     * @param CollectionProcessorInterface $collectionProcessor
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ItemResource $resource,
        private readonly ItemFactory $itemFactory,
        private readonly CollectionFactory $collectionFactory,
        private readonly ItemSearchResultsInterfaceFactory $searchResultsFactory,
        private readonly CollectionProcessorInterface $collectionProcessor
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function save(ItemInterface $item): ItemInterface
    {
        if (!$item instanceof Item) {
            throw new CouldNotSaveException(__('Unsupported item implementation: %1', get_class($item)));
        }
        if ($item->getId()) {
            $existing = $this->load((int)$item->getId());
            $existing->addData($item->getData());
            $item = $existing;
        }
        try {
            $this->resource->save($item);
        } catch (AlreadyExistsException $e) {
            throw new CouldNotSaveException(__('An item with code "%1" already exists.', $item->getCode()), $e);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            throw new CouldNotSaveException(__('Could not save the item: %1', $e->getMessage()), $e);
        }
        return $item;
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function getById(int $itemId): ItemInterface
    {
        return $this->load($itemId);
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function getByCode(string $code): ItemInterface
    {
        $item = $this->itemFactory->create();
        $this->resource->load($item, $code, ItemInterface::CODE);
        if (!$item->getId()) {
            throw NoSuchEntityException::singleField(ItemInterface::CODE, $code);
        }
        return $item;
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function getList(SearchCriteriaInterface $searchCriteria): ItemSearchResultsInterface
    {
        $collection = $this->collectionFactory->create();
        $this->collectionProcessor->process($searchCriteria, $collection);

        $searchResults = $this->searchResultsFactory->create();
        $searchResults->setSearchCriteria($searchCriteria);
        $searchResults->setItems($collection->getItems());
        $searchResults->setTotalCount($collection->getSize());
        return $searchResults;
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function delete(ItemInterface $item): bool
    {
        try {
            $this->resource->delete($item);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            throw new CouldNotDeleteException(__('Could not delete the item: %1', $e->getMessage()), $e);
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function deleteById(int $itemId): bool
    {
        return $this->delete($this->load($itemId));
    }

    /**
     * @param int $itemId
     * @return Item
     * @throws NoSuchEntityException
     */
    private function load(int $itemId): Item
    {
        $item = $this->itemFactory->create();
        $this->resource->load($item, $itemId);
        if (!$item->getId()) {
            throw NoSuchEntityException::singleField('id', $itemId);
        }
        return $item;

use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;

use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

/**
 * Consumer (handler in etc/queue_consumer.xml): the argument type is the topic's request type.
 *
 * Pattern: reload the entity by id (it may have changed or been deleted since publishing);
 * a permanent failure is logged and swallowed, otherwise the message is retried forever.
 */
class ItemSavedConsumer
{
    /**
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     * @param ItemNotificationSender $sender
     * @param LoggerInterface $logger
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository,
        private readonly ItemNotificationSender $sender,
        private readonly LoggerInterface $logger
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param string $itemId
     * @return void
     */
    public function process(string $itemId): void
    {
        try {
            $this->sender->send($this->itemRepository->getById((int)$itemId));
        } catch (NoSuchEntityException $e) {
            $this->logger->info('Item removed before the notification was sent', ['item_id' => $itemId]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->logger->error('Item notification failed', ['item_id' => $itemId, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
    }
}

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;

use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Exception\GraphQlNoSuchEntityException;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Query\ResolverInterface;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Schema\Type\ResolveInfo;

/**
 * Query acmeReferenceItem(code): one enabled item. A disabled item answers exactly like a missing
 * one, so the public API does not reveal what exists.
 */
class Item implements ResolverInterface
{
    /**
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     * @param ItemFormatter $formatter
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository,
        private readonly ItemFormatter $formatter
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function resolve(Field $field, $context, ResolveInfo $info, ?array $value = null, ?array $args = null)
    {
        $code = trim((string)($args['code'] ?? ''));
        try {
            $item = $this->itemRepository->getByCode(strtoupper($code));
        } catch (NoSuchEntityException $e) {
            $item = null;
        }
        if ($item === null || $item->getStatus() !== ItemInterface::STATUS_ENABLED) {
            throw new GraphQlNoSuchEntityException(__('No item with code "%1".', $code));
        }
        return $this->formatter->format($item);
    }
}

namespace Acme\Reference\Model\Resolver\Item;

use Acme\Reference\Model\Item;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Query\Resolver\IdentityInterface;

/**
 * Cache tags of the GraphQL answers (@cache(cacheIdentity: ...) in schema.graphqls). The tags are the
 * same that Item::getIdentities() cleans on save, so a cached answer never outlives the data.
 * Handles both shapes: a list ({items: [...]}) and a single item.
 */
class Identity implements IdentityInterface
{
    /**
     * @param array $resolvedData
     * @return string[]
     */
    public function getIdentities(array $resolvedData): array
    {
        $items = isset($resolvedData['items']) ? (array)$resolvedData['items'] : [$resolvedData];
        $tags = [Item::CACHE_TAG];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if (!empty($item['id'])) {
                $tags[] = Item::CACHE_TAG . '_' . $item['id'];
            }
        }
        return $tags;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Reference\Model\Resolver;

use Acme\Reference\Api\Data\ItemInterface;
use Acme\Reference\Api\ItemRepositoryInterface;
use Magento\Framework\Api\SearchCriteriaBuilder;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Config\Element\Field;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Exception\GraphQlInputException;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Query\ResolverInterface;
use Magento\Framework\GraphQl\Schema\Type\ResolveInfo;

/**
 * Query acmeReferenceItems: a public, paged list of ENABLED items.
 *
 * Pattern: validate the arguments (GraphQlInputException = message the client sees); public queries
 * always force the visibility filter on the server; read through the repository; return arrays
 * shaped like the schema type; page_info follows the core SearchResultPageInfo.
 */
class Items implements ResolverInterface
{
    /**
     * @param ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository
     * @param SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder
     * @param ItemFormatter $formatter
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ItemRepositoryInterface $itemRepository,
        private readonly SearchCriteriaBuilder $searchCriteriaBuilder,
        private readonly ItemFormatter $formatter
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @inheritdoc
     */
    public function resolve(Field $field, $context, ResolveInfo $info, ?array $value = null, ?array $args = null)
    {
        $pageSize = (int)($args['pageSize'] ?? 20);
        $currentPage = (int)($args['currentPage'] ?? 1);
        if ($pageSize < 1 || $pageSize > 100) {
            throw new GraphQlInputException(__('pageSize must be between 1 and 100.'));
        }
        if ($currentPage < 1) {
            throw new GraphQlInputException(__('currentPage must be greater than 0.'));
        }

        $this->searchCriteriaBuilder->addFilter(ItemInterface::STATUS, ItemInterface::STATUS_ENABLED);
        if (isset($args['filter']['code']['eq'])) {
            $this->searchCriteriaBuilder->addFilter(ItemInterface::CODE, (string)$args['filter']['code']['eq']);
        }
        if (isset($args['filter']['name']['match'])) {
            $this->searchCriteriaBuilder->addFilter(ItemInterface::NAME, '%' . $args['filter']['name']['match'] . '%', 'like');
        }
        $criteria = $this->searchCriteriaBuilder->setPageSize($pageSize)->setCurrentPage($currentPage)->create();
        $result = $this->itemRepository->getList($criteria);

        $items = [];
        foreach ($result->getItems() as $item) {
            $items[] = $this->formatter->format($item);
        }
        return [
            'items' => $items,
            'total_count' => $result->getTotalCount(),
            'page_info' => [
                'page_size' => $pageSize,
                'current_page' => $currentPage,
                'total_pages' => (int)ceil($result->getTotalCount() / $pageSize),
            ],
        ];
    }
}
